meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Applies the DHDNA framework as an exploratory rubric for reasoning and writing patterns in supplied text. Use when the user asks for DHDNA, cognitive-style reflection, a thinking-pattern profile, or comparisons of textual reasoning. Scores describe evidence in the sample, not validated psychological traits or personal identity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析一段文字,描绘它的思考方式与写作模式画像
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想弄清一段文字里的思考与写作习惯。
copy.tagline_en: Profile the reasoning and writing patterns inside a piece of text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to map the reasoning and writing habits in a piece of text.

howto.what: 给一段文字,它按 DHDNA 框架为 12 个认知维度逐项打 1–10 分并附引文证据,再给出主导模式、阴影模式、推理拓扑和决策指纹;多篇不同作者的文字可作对比。分数只描述样本中的证据。
howto.when: 当你要求做 DHDNA、认知风格反思、思维模式画像,或比较不同文本的推理方式时触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字作者的思维风格,给我 12 个维度的打分
say.note: 输出维度分数与对应引文证据

say.text: 把这两篇文章作者的认知风格对比一下
say.note: 先各出画像,再给对比综述

say.text: 用 DHDNA 框架看看我在这次对话里是怎么思考的
say.note: 以对话记录为样本,并提示样本局限

howto.what_en: Given text, it scores 12 cognitive dimensions 1–10 with quoted evidence, then reports dominant/shadow patterns, reasoning topology and decision fingerprint. Two or more authors can be compared. Scores describe the sample, not the person.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for DHDNA, a cognitive-style or thinking-pattern profile, or a comparison of reasoning across texts.

say_en.text: Profile the author's thinking style in this text with the 12 DHDNA scores
Compare the cognitive styles of these two writers
Use DHDNA to look at how I reason in this conversation
say_en.note: Profiles the chat and flags sample limits
